definitions.gloss: case (of a disease); clinical case; instance of illness
definitions.explanation: An individual occurrence of a disease or medical condition. Used in medical reports, research, and news coverage of health topics.

examples.japanese: ⟦{珍|めずら}しい→珍しい：01200_mezurashii⟧{症例|しょうれい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{報告|ほうこく}→報告：03618_houkoku⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{感染|かんせん}→感染：05977_kansen⟧{症例|しょうれい}{数|すう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{去年|きょねん}→去年：00727_kyonen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上回|うわまわ}っている→上回る：07648_uwamawaru⟧。
examples.english: The number of infection cases this year exceeds last year's.

examples.english: We will examine treatment methods based on case reports.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal, medical/scientific term frequently seen in news reports about outbreaks, research papers, and hospital settings. Not used in casual conversation about being sick.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {症例|しょうれい}⟦{報告|ほうこく}→報告：03618_houkoku⟧ (case report)
- {症例|しょうれい}{数|すう} (number of cases)
- {症例|しょうれい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{分析|ぶんせき}する→分析する：25338_bunsekisuru⟧ (to analyze cases)
- ⟦{重症|じゅうしょう}→重症：09792_juushou⟧{症例|しょうれい} (severe cases)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{事例|じれい}→事例：11417_jirei⟧: example, precedent — broader, not limited to medical contexts
- ⟦{患者|かんじゃ}→患者：00170_kanja⟧: patient — the person, not the case
- ⟦{奨励|しょうれい}→奨励：12213_shourei⟧: encouragement — a homophone with different kanji and meaning
